summary: Two degree tracks run in parallel and deliberately feed different halves of the same goal: the technical programs build the ability to make intelligent systems, and the international business studies build the judgment about contracts, markets, and rules that decide how those systems should be used.

entries.notes: AUPP operates an accredited dual-degree partnership with Fort Hays State University. The 20 October 2025 start date is owner-confirmed. The scholarship is certified by a rector-signed award dated 30 April 2025 granting a 100% bachelor's-degree scholarship as second-place laureate in mathematics; the certificate is held privately and shown on request. Whether the award renews annually or covers the full programme is not stated on it.
Completed through the AUPP–FHSU dual-degree partnership, so it runs on the same 20 October 2025 start.

entries.institution: Institute of Foreign Languages (IFL), Royal University of Phnom Penh
entries.scholarship: 100% four-year Ministry of Justice scholarship — Grade A, Bac II 2025
entries.notes: IFL's Department of English runs the B.A. in English for Work Skills over four years: Years I–III are shared coursework, and students take a Year-IV major in English for International Business, Translation and Interpreting, or English for Professional Communication. Enrolment began 1 January 2026, so International Business is the declared direction rather than a finished specialisation. The place is funded by a 100% four-year bachelor's scholarship awarded by Cambodia's Ministry of Justice for study at RUPP, IFL's parent university, on a Grade A result in the national Bac II examination in 2025; the ministry's official recipient list for the 2025–2026 academic year names twenty students across several majors and is held privately, since it carries other students' personal data. This is the coursework behind the Governance & Commercial Rules pillar — contracts, terms, policies, and commercial rules.
